---
title: Browse the code
description: Read the files behind your site in Console → Code. Changes still go through the chat.
sidebar:
  order: 8
---

You never have to read code to build a site, but you can. **Code** shows the files the builder wrote, so you can check what it changed.

1. Click **Console** in the header, then **Code**. It shows the files of the App chosen in the header's App switcher.
2. Open a folder under **FILES** and click a file. For the coffee shop the folders include `migrations`, `public`, `scripts` and `src`, and `src/App.tsx` lists the pages of the site.
3. Read the file in the editor on the right. It opens in a tab, and the path of the open file is shown at the top.
4. Click **Back to Console** to return to the other Console sections.

![Console → Code for The Cozy Coffee Table: the FILES tree on the left and src/App.tsx open in a read-only editor.](/images/build/code-1.webp)

The toolbar above the editor has the buttons **Files**, **Quick Open**, **Search**, **Refresh**, **Copy path**, **Copy content**, **Download file** and **Copy link**, plus **More actions**.

## Good to know

- Code is read only. To change the site, ask in the chat on the left. See [Describe what you want](/build/describe/).
- **Copy path** is handy when you want to point the builder at a file: paste the path into your message.
- **Refresh** reloads the list of files, for example after the builder has added some.
- Code shows the draft that Preview shows, not what is live.
